Hey Product Hunt, I’m Andrew, and I built Notif.When you write a note, Notif adds two things: a short tip about it and a button for the next step. “Renew my passport” gets a reminder that many countries want six months left on it, plus a button to travel.state.gov. “Pick up the dry cleaning” gets a button to find a dry cleaner nearby.Every note is a real reminder in Apple Reminders, so there’s nothing new to learn, and it shows up on all your devices, with Siri and widgets. It works on iPhone, iPad and the new iPhone Duo.New in 2.0: private notes are encrypted on your iPhone, your note’s button opens the app you already use, and Pro adds a daily plan on iOS 27 with Apple Intelligence.It’s free with no account: you get a tip a day, and Pro puts one on every note. I’d love to hear what you’d use it for and what you’d want next.

Weboldal: https://trynotif.app
